source: Robert's direct manual company-profile walkthrough feedback, 18 October 2026
status: Recorded only; no implementation or tests until Robert explicitly releases the agent.

presentation.repair: Reduce dead space in top-right green area. Balance heading/introduction/dividers across the available width; current two-thirds divider and empty right area feel unfinished. Align sidebar blue/typeface with approved charcoal/green branding.

navigation.problem: Section anchor navigation scrolls the section choices/header out of view.
navigation.direction: Prefer one compact content panel at a time (Company basics, Work & story, Your people, etc.), with section choices remaining available at the top rather than a long stacked form. Sticky navigation was suggested before clarifying panel-by-panel preference.
navigation.bounds: Preserve unsaved edits and existing save semantics while designing panels. No new autosave, per-panel persistence, hidden-field omission or mandatory-step policy selected.

approved: Prepopulated company name and work description from initial setup
companyBasics.accreditations: Free-text repeatable entries: type an accreditation, add it to a list, then add another. Not a restrictive dropdown. Examples of specialist fire, testing, gas/utility accreditation motivate the requirement; no statutory list or verified accreditation/eligibility claim selected.
companyBasics.openQuestion: Robert asked whether further company information is needed; review gaps after the tour without inventing required fields.

retain: Capability statement and optional rewrite affordance
workAndStory.tradeProblem: The exhaustive trade checklist repeats initial discovery and presents unrelated works (piling/asbestos/utilities/RC) to an already-identified kitchen business.
workAndStory.direction: Keep useful broader classification internally, but make the visible journey coherent with the contractor's earlier description. Avoid asking unrelated categories again. Exact mapping/selection/adaptive behaviour still to design; no silent inference of capabilities or overwriting selections.

moveToOtherPaths.caseStudies: Past projects/case studies belong in their own welcome tile/path, not embedded profile content. Existing page is available.
moveToOtherPaths.clarification: Keep operational estimation and proposal stages distinct despite a clearer common first-proposal entry.

benchmarking: Robert said Industry Benchmarking is fine in this review. This is not verification of current anonymisation/withdrawal claims or permission to enable data collection; platform terms/privacy workstream remains separate. Existing checkbox left unchecked.
execution: Profile read-only, confirmed No unsaved changes; used existing Go to case studies link. No profile save/edit/theme/consent selection, AI, upload, provider, test or implementation.
